offerings.name: Tavily Search
offerings.pricing: Credit-based: Basic (basic): each request costs 1 API credit; Advanced (advanced): each request costs 2 API credits. Plan prices: Researcher 1,000 credits/month Free; Project 4,000 credits $30 ($0.0075/credit); Bootstrap 15,000 credits $100 ($0.0067/credit); Startup 38,000 credits $220 ($0.0058/credit); Growth 100,000 credits $500 ($0.005/credit); Pay as you go $0.008/credit; Enterprise custom pricing
offerings.price_basis: Pay-as-you-go ($0.008/credit) × basic search depth = 1 credit per request; monthly plans range $5–$7.5 per 1,000 basic searches
offerings.free_quota: You get 1,000 free API Credits every month. No credit card required.
offerings.output_type: JSON 结构化搜索结果，含 answer（LLM 生成的简短答案，默认 include_answer=false）、results[]（title/url/content/score/raw_content/published_date/favicon/images）、images、response_time、usage.credits、request_id
offerings.note: search_depth: basic/fast/ultra-fast=1 credit，advanced=2 credits；max_results 上限 20（默认 10）；auto_parameters 开启后可能自动设为 advanced（每次 2 credits）。
